title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（中沢憲二研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Nakazawa Kenji)
teachers:
NAKAZAWA Kenji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students are given the opportunity to summarize what they have learned by finding a unique theme related to media information, thinking about a problem related to that theme, and then going through a scientific process in order to formulate and propose a solution. Based on the knowledge learned in specialized seminars, etc., the project design method embodied by CDIO cycle is utilized and each student’s ability to become a creative engineer is cultivated.
advice:
Project Design III is based on the first- to third-year class contents of the Department of Media Informatics
In this course, students will work on individual themes. Within that process, they will practice problem finding and problem solving techniques and construct deliverables based on the advice and guidance of their faculty adviser.
The result is the culmination of four years of university life.
Based on the knowledge and skills of specialized subjects acquired so far, students will further deepen their understanding of their specialized fields and learn problem finding, investigation, and solution methods. In addition, students can be expected to acquire the ability to specifically design, develop, and evaluate those fields.

Learning Tips:
Project Design III is a full-year, eight-credit class during which students will work on individual project themes to produce results.
To do so, it will be necessary for them to develop proper self-management skills. We strongly encourage students to actively acquire the skills and knowledge necessary for their theme.
requiredKnowledge:
All required courses up to the second year of this department must have already been completed.
Students must be able to summarize what they have learned from the first to third years.
Each student is required to have mastered, through class experience, how to find and solve problems in Project Design I/II and through project design practice.

activityGoals.body: Be able to build a foundation as a creative engineer using problem discovery and solution techniques.
Be able to explain things related to specialized fields.
Be able to deepen insight individual insights into “engineer ethics”.
Be able to apply existing expertise to project themes.
Be able to conduct CDIO-based research and development on the set project theme.
